data.title: Humanoid resources: China's robots search for workforce breakthrough
data.description: A horde of schoolchildren watched excitedly as a diminutive humanoid tour guide named Wuji welcomed them to a robot school in eastern China, gesticulating theatrically as it described the institute's aspiration to train the mechanical workforce of the future.Companies enrol robots, who are evaluated and given training tailored to their "future role in the workplace".
